description: The Wedge  The wedge is used to display hierarchical data through a series of concentric nested rings. Customised colours make it easy to distinguish between multiple levels within categories at a glance. Great Scenarios to Use the Wedge Use the Wedge to display hierarchical data at different levels and is particularly effective when you have multiple levels within categories and want to understand the contribution of each level to the whole. Why Choose Our Wedge Is by far the best Sunburst visual on the market now!  Visually stimulates more relative thinking and easy to understand. Working from the inside to the outer circle our Wedge combines the hierarchical structure, categorised data and segment size relative to the data it represents. Importantly, the colour palette stands out in contrasting wedges and the Wedge has ability to hover over a segment for relative data. please note: this visual does not support large data or negative values
